invariants: one rendered workbench binds all sections to one immutable snapshot_id and one business as_of
contract_version, schema_version, generated_at, trace_id, partial, missing_sections and source_watermarks are explicit
a legal zero, an empty collection, an unavailable value and a stale value are distinct states
a failed projection becomes an explicit partial section and is never replaced by fixture or display-derived data
tenant and field trimming are decided by authenticated server-side authorization, not request parameters
domain.compensation: disable the additive snapshot profile and retain the preserved legacy read operations without mutating business state

data.migration: additive common response profile; domain snapshot manifests and migrations remain owned by their feature contracts

negative_tests: a request tenant parameter cannot override the authenticated tenant
a source timeout cannot expose another tenant or be rendered as a zero-valued complete result

stop_conditions: source time skew, unbounded fanout, P99 or resource use exceeds the approved domain budget

tests: G0 OpenAPI and generated TypeScript metadata shape
G1 Go common envelope and zero/empty/partial semantics
G2 real dashboard asset and topic snapshot services
G3 source watermark and sampled fact reconciliation
G4 fixed-scale complete and partial response profile
G5 Windows Chrome mock-off same-snapshot rendering
G6 canary rollback to preserved reads
evidence: one candidate-bound trace links browser payload, snapshot manifest, source watermarks and sampled source facts
